name: KINLINK Continuity & Comms
purpose: repair orphaned Gmail START/END transitions with normal human French without imposing any fixed duration on active engineering work
invariants: Intermediate PDF/report/artifact mail is neither START nor END unless explicitly typed.
Never send duplicate END after provider ACK already exists.
Recovered END emails use normal human French.
Active work is never closed solely because of age; only explicit close intent/provider mismatch/orphan transition can trigger repair.
idempotency: Provider message_id/thread_id plus delivery_key are reconciliation keys.
limitation: Hourly automation is a failover/reconciliation layer only. It is not a timer and does not define tranche duration.

stale_work_recovery.condition: CLOSE_INTENT_PERSISTED or END_SEND_PENDING without durable provider ACK, or durable/provider state mismatch.
stale_work_recovery.action: read Gmail/provider state; persist existing ACK or send exactly one truthful human END; persist CLOSED

foreground_resume.rule: After a repaired close and absent true human/security gate, a fresh START may resume real next work; do not fabricate progress.

close_intent_priority.rule: Only explicit CLOSE_INTENT_PERSISTED/END_SEND_PENDING is a P0 missed-END transition; active WORKING age alone is not.
close_intent_priority.repair: verify provider state first; then persist ACK or send exactly one human explanatory END

email_style.parity_rule: same substantive explanation as chat; never machine-only status prose
